### Steps to Review
1. From a terminal/command prompt in the project root directory run the command `git checkout develop`
2. Run the command `git fetch`
3. Run the command `git pull`
4. Check out the current branch for testing via `git checkout <branch name here>`
5. Set up the development environment by following the steps in the [repository README](https://github.com/msu-denver/bili-core#readme)
6. Run `pylint bili/ --fail-under=9` to confirm the lint gate passes
7. Run `pytest bili/` to execute the test suite
